lyrics:
[Intro: ukulele chop, finger snaps, a laugh]

[Verse 1: light sing-rap male voice, grinning]
I had a five-year plan with a color-coded chart
Dream job, dream car, dream girl, dream start
Showed it to you once, real quick, like, "sign here, please"
You read the whole thing over and you laughed at me

[Chorus: bouncy, 808 and claps, singalong]
You ruined my plans, thank you
Tore 'em up, threw 'em out, thank you
I wanted a puddle, you gave me the sea
I wanted my way, you wanted me free
Best thing that ever happened to me
You ruined my plans, thank you

[Verse 2: sing-rap, beat fuller]
Fishermen had a business, nets and a boat
You walked by, said two words, and they just up and go
Tax man in a tree, girl at a well
Everybody's plans got wrecked, and they're all doing well

[Chorus: bouncy, 808 and claps, singalong]
You ruined my plans, thank you
Tore 'em up, threw 'em out, thank you
I wanted a puddle, you gave me the sea
I wanted my way, you wanted me free
Best thing that ever happened to me
You ruined my plans, thank you, Jesus

[Bridge: beat drops, ukulele, half-spoken]
"Not my will." That's a hard one to say
You said it first, in a garden, the night before the day
That saved the world
So. Okay. Your way.

[Final Chorus: everything in, friends shouting along]
You ruined my plans, thank you
Tore 'em up, threw 'em out, thank you
I wanted a puddle, you gave me the sea
I wanted my way, you wanted me free
Best thing that ever happened to me
You ruined my plans, thank you, Jesus

[Outro: ukulele, spoken]
What's the plan now?
No idea.
Perfect.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 100 BPM, 4/4 with a bounce, C major. Sunny, light and quick, a song to dance to in a kitchen.

VOICE: Young male, light and close, half-sung and half-rapped with a smile you can hear. Doubled an octave up in the choruses. Friends shout along in the last chorus. The bridge is nearly spoken and suddenly sincere. Three spoken lines at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A chopped ukulele figure, finger snaps and handclaps, a round 808 kick and bass, a crisp rimshot, a bright bell-like synth, a short vocal chop used as a hook.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, ukulele and snaps. 0:08 Verse 1. 0:28 Chorus 1. 0:50 Verse 2, the fishermen. 1:10 Chorus 2, the name. 1:32 Bridge, beat out. 1:50 Final chorus with friends. 2:14 Outro, three spoken lines, ends 2:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2024 bedroom pop: clean, bright, dry and minimal, big soft low end, vocals right at the front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'So. Okay. Your way.' at 1:46.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 could be addressed to a girlfriend or a mentor. Verse 2 at 0:50 lists the fishermen, Zacchaeus and the woman at the well, and the second chorus ends on the name. The bridge goes to Gethsemane in three careful lines.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Cocky, laughing at himself, grateful, free.
